correctness.rationale: For X=V(sum x_i^2 x_{i+1}) over Z_(5), nonzero common partial derivatives force (-2)^5=1, false in Q and F5. Fixed projective eigenlines of the cyclic 5-permutation give t^5=1 and cubic restriction t Phi_5(t), hence precisely Phi_5=0. In the invariant-line Grassmann chart, independently built recurrence x_{i+2}=-a x_{i+1}-b x_i, four cubic coefficients and two T^5-1 remainder coefficients yield Groebner basis (b-1,a^2-a-1) over Q and in F5. Every geometric invariant 2-plane lies on this chart, with unique special-fiber 2-plane; finiteness, flat quadratic subscheme and Nakayama rule out extra torsion. Eisenstein shifts and discriminants 125/5 give lengths 4/2. The tangent representations follow from quotienting the regular unipotent Jordan 5-block; n=3 and 2 blocks. Independent symbolic computations corroborated all finite algebraic identities, not projective finiteness.
residual_risks: Fano-scheme finiteness and Nakayama need the complete proof, not just finite Groebner output.
